title: incident-bot + slo-toolkit: oncall diagnostics and runbook linking enhancements
author: Monica Chen
description:
Motivation: Improve incident-bot's on-call diagnostics by enriching SLO context from slo-toolkit, prioritizing runbook suggestions, and adding lightweight sampling heuristics to reduce noise. This PR wires slo-toolkit utilities into the incident-bot workflow, adds telemetry for diagnostics ranking, and improves runbook autolinking precision.

What I changed: 1) incident-bot: oncall diagnostics pipeline updates to include SLO metadata (project, objective, burn rate), new diagnostic hints scoring, runbook autolink improvements (fuzzy matching + threshold). 2) slo-toolkit: exported utilities for SLO context enrichment and sampling heuristics. 3) Telemetry: added metrics incident_bot.diagnostics.score_distribution and incident_bot.runbook.link_success. 4) Tests: unit + integration tests for enriched payloads and prioritization logic. 5) Docs: updated runbook linking README and runbook examples.

Testing and rollout: Unit tests + integration tests passed CI. Deployed to staging for 48h and sampled on-call traffic; no regressions observed. Feature is gated behind experiment flag incident_bot_enhanced_diag (default off) and rollout plan is gradual by team.

Checklist: - [x] Add SLO context enrichment utilities - [x] Integrate into incident-bot pipeline - [x] Add metrics and dashboards - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Add feature flag and rollout plan

Related: Linear ENG-3267, ENG-3412; previous PRs pr-137890 and pr-812345 for incident-bot runbook linking.

Notes: No breaking changes. Small telemetry spike expected on rollout; alerting adjusted to ignore low-volume anomalies.

Lucas Meyer: Can we gate this behind a feature flag per-team?
Monica: Yes  added incident_bot_enhanced_diag flag and rollout plan in deploy/feature-flags.
